contest_sizes.name: contest_sizes
contest_sizes.value: "contest"."capacity" >= 2 and "contest"."min_entries" between 2 and "contest"."capacity" and "contest"."entry_count" between 0 and "contest"."capacity"

voucher_used_or_cancelled.name: voucher_used_or_cancelled
voucher_used_or_cancelled.value: not ("voucher"."used_at" is not null and "voucher"."cancelled_at" is not null)
